thesis: The speakers argue that the investment recommendation is fundamentally the pitch, and without the ability to effectively communicate an idea to a portfolio manager, the research is irrelevant regardless of its quality. They further contend that the book's narrative structure reflects this conclusion, where the process of finding an investment is only complete when the idea can be successfully pitched to achieve adoption and position scaling.
